text: The ___ theorem guarantees existence and uniqueness of weak solutions to elliptic PDEs given a bounded, coercive bilinear form on a Hilbert space.
explanation: Lax-Milgram provides existence and uniqueness for the weak (variational) formulation a(u,v) = l(v) when a is bounded and coercive, underpinning the finite element method. Coercivity is the key hypothesis, generalizing positive-definiteness.
